message:
Hey friends! 🌟 We all know that sinking feeling when the power goes out, especially when you’re in the middle of something important on your phone or laptop. I’ve found that having a little plan in place can really ease those moments. The Red Cross has some great tips on how to prepare for a power outage, from making sure your devices are charged to having cozy candles at the ready. It’s all about being prepared without the panic! 

What’s your go-to tip for staying calm during a blackout?
